ghidra.limitations: Raw import omits external helpers and globals; current Win64 assembly and replay own floating returns and ABI.

seams: Movement supplies controlled primary/secondary terrain results and records queries. Terrain mesh/loading/collision internals are not executed.
Movement records the packet helper arguments; the separate packet replay executes its framing instructions.
Packet replay substitutes allocation/vector growth, packed GUID and XYZ append helpers; duration, serial, opcode, facing, flags and point count execute natively.
limitations: Static 0.112.0 boundary recovery, not MPQ terrain navigation, packet playback, game execution or parity validation.
